description: A trigger is the event that starts an automation: a new order, a new contact, 9:00 on Monday. The three kinds, and why some are not instant.
h1: What is a trigger in automation?
definition: A trigger is the event that starts an automation: a new order in Shopify, a new contact in HubSpot, 9:00 on a Monday.
Every automation has at least one, and nothing in it runs until a trigger fires.

example.ask: Set up an automation: every new Shopify order is added as a row to my Google Sheet with its items and total
example.why: The trigger is a new order in Shopify. It hands the next step the order, its items and total, and that step writes them into a row.
